text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Start of the return of Jordanian Haj pilgrims from Saudi Arabia.
- Closure of the King Hussein bridge (Allenby bridge) across the West Bank on Monday because of a Jewish holiday, a bridge official says.
- Jordanians entitled to U.N. compensation over losses incurred during the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait receive their approved claims.
- Political figures try to narrow gaps between the views of the opposition and the government to pave the way for amendments to the election law ahead of parliamentary elections next November.
- Health minister says measles outbreak is under control.
- Over a quarter million Jordanians visited touristic sites around the Dead Sea during the holiday break.
